pieces.Text: This discovery allows you to fuel your mutagen with psionic power in order to become combustible.  Anyone striking you with a melee weapon while under the effects of this discovery takes

d6 points fire damage.  Creatures making melee attacks from more than 5 ft. away with reach weapons do not suffer this damage.  If you die from the attack, all creatures within 10 feet of the mutator take
d6 fire damage as your body bursts in a fiery explosion.
